messages:
ana: Heads-up: discovered a small but consistent invoice delta after the route-tag normalization that landed last week. Symptoms: low-volume tenants see fractional token attribution shifts (~0.2-0.6%) causing preview diffs. Shadow run showed the pattern correlates with tags containing unicode accents.

omar: Interesting. Are we normalizing unicode to NFKC? We currently just lowercase + trim.

rachel: Dashboard impact: invoice preview groups by route_tag hash. Non-normalized vs normalized keys produce split rows and small rounding errors when we aggregate float token counts. Users see preview ~= actual +- a few cents.

tom: Telemetry: add meter.tag.normalize_form and meter.tag.unicode_folded boolean. Also emit meter.recon.rounding_cents to estimate $ impact per-tenant.

billing-bot: job:tag-normalization-shadower active at 7065432200 sample=100% read-shadow.

omar: Proposal: fold unicode accents and map visually-identical punctuation to ascii equivalents during normalization. We'll version the normalizer (v2) and run side-by-side.

rachel: For the console, can we mark preview rows that differ due to normalization with a small badge and offer "explain diff" that shows raw vs normalized tag and cents difference? Support team would love that.

tom: Gate logic: nightly-reconciler will compute rounding_cents per-tenant. If tenant rounding_cents > $5 OR rounding_percent > 0.5% hold out of write canary. Also add alert when total rounding_cents across all tenants > $200 in 24h.

anа: (typo in name intentionally to simulate unicode) ana: Re: holdout mechanics: we should be able to exclude tenants by id via k.recon.exclude_list; canary should be per-tenant.

sre-oncall: Runbook: If rounding_cents pushes >$500 in 24h, page billing@ and flip k.flag.tag_norm=v1 for affected shards. Rollback command documented in runbook.

omar: Implementation note: avoid rewriting ledger entries. We'll tag events with meter.event.tag_norm_version and leave historic invoices intact. Reconciliation UI will surface candidate manual credits.

rachel: UI ETA: 2 days for badge + explain panel. Need paired API returning {raw, normalized, delta_cents} for sample rows.

tom: I'll add metrics and dashboard cards: meter.tag.unicode_folded, meter.recon.rounding_cents, meter.tag.norm_version. Also run a backfill sampler to estimate historical exposure.

ana: thanks all. follow-ups: @omar normalizer PR, @tom metrics + alert, @rachel console badge + explain API, @sre-oncall update runbook. We'll evaluate after first nightly run.
